certification.name: Offensive Development Practitioner Certification
certification.description: Covers development of custom offensive tooling such as shellcode loaders, reflective payloads and process injection, with AMSI and ETW bypass, API unhooking and EDR evasion. Assessed by a 48-hour practical exam in a student-deployed AWS lab followed by 48 hours to submit a report.
certification.currency_note: Course with lifetime access and one exam voucher that does not expire; page shows 'starting at' USD 700
